item.title: Tom Cruise's Favorite Director's Breakout Action Thriller Is Officially Free to Stream
item.description: As strange as it may be from a modern perspective, there was a point at which Christopher McQuarrie did not work with Tom Cruise. 20 years before McQuarrie directed four Mission: Impossible movies in a row, he got on moviegoers' radar by writing the Oscar-winning script for 1995's The Usual Suspects .

item.title: Prime Video's Near-Perfect Game of Thrones Replacement Officially Arrives in 2 Months
item.description: A weak king rules over a cobbled-together kingdom that's already coming apart at the seams. Various heroes and villains compete and scheme to claim the throne. A new challenger rises up from across the sea, full of vengeance and bloodlust... If that sounds like the premise of Game of Thrones , well, that's because it is, but it's also the set-up for Prime Video's thrilling new action drama from one of the 21st-century's most successful (and underappreciated) showrunners.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s No. 1 cause of death officially revealed
item.description: The Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has officially been out for more than two weeks, and saying its reception has been good would be an understatement. It was named the No. 2 best-selling game on the Nintendo Switch 2 , with over 5.2 million copies reportedly sold less than four days after launch. Longtime Zelda fans and newcomers alike have been enjoying revisiting the 1998 classic in this remake.

item.title: 17 Years Ago, the Longest Running Sci-Fi Show Flipped Its Core Concept On Its Head
item.description: If there’s one thing you can’t say about Tennant, it’s that he lacks range. He can play a lover, a fighter, or the scummiest person you know. But his most iconic role as the time-traveling alien known as the Doctor in the sci-fi family show Doctor Who brings all three together.

item.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Is Finally Getting Capcom’s Fastest-Selling Game Ever
item.description: With the success of Resident Evil Requiem , Pragmata , and Onimusha: Way of the Sword , it's safe to say that Capcom has had a fantastic 2026. And the venerable developer's 2025 wasn't too shabby either. Last February, it released Monster Hunter Wilds for PlayStation 5, Windows PC, and Xbox Series X. It went on to sell a whopping eight million copies in just three days, making it the company's fastest-selling game of all time. As of September 2026, Monster Hunter Wilds has sold 12.2 million copies , making it Capcom's 11th-best-selling game of all time. That number is set to go up significantly after Dec. 4, when it finally launches for Nintendo Switch 2.

item.title: GTA 6 Trophy Count and Full Completion Time Leaks in New Reports
item.description: Millions of players will start their adventure in Leonida with the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 later this week. They're currently preparing themselves and completing the games they've left unfinished so they can dedicate all of their time to GTA 6 soon — especially gamers who have asked for time off from work to play it. But the question on many players' minds is how much time they will need to finish the story and 100% complete it.

item.title: All map fragment locations in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite 's Chapter 7 mini season , "Treasure Hunters," has added a new collectible to find throughout the season: map fragments . These map fragments will be added periodically during the season, and you'll get a special reward for finding them all.

item.title: 8 Must-Play Open-World RPGs for People With Real-Life Schedules
item.description: Raise your hand if this has ever happened to you: A friend texts you a screenshot of a map with 400 icons on it and the message “you’re going to love this game.” You’re excited — the map is detailed, the game looks great, and you do love it…for about 10 seconds. Until you check your calendar and remember that you’ve got a dentist appointment, three work deadlines, and a birthday dinner to prepare for, so that map is going to have to stay unexplored for a minute. (My hand is raised.)

item.title: The 2026 GOTY Race Could Be a Disaster for Indie Games
item.description: Some quibble with the definition of Clair Obscur , a sizable production, as an indie game. (For what it's worth, the studio that made it is independent, and its publisher Kepler Interactive was founded by a collective of indie studios; it's definitely culturally indie.) But even if you excluded it, this was still the first time more than one game had crossed over between the indie and GOTY categories in the history of the awards.

item.title: Super Meat Boy Is Officially Getting Remade Without Edmund McMillen's Involvement
item.description: Team Meat announced Super Meat Boy Again+ , a remake of the classic indie platformer, during a Sweet 16 Birthday VIP Event on Nov. 14. While the announcement was meant to be celebratory, it has reminded people of the falling out that Super Meat Boy and Mewgenics creator Edmund McMillen has had with Team Meat, as he is not involved in the new project.
